content.short: Define Protocol is a privacy-preserving proof of talenthood protocol.
content.description: Define Protocol seeks to redefine talent identity and reputation through decentralization and privacy-preserving technology. It envisions a future in which individuals retain autonomy over their professional standing and engage with others in a secure, seamless manner powered by blockchain. By reimagining digital identity, Define Protocol enables people to affirm their personhood while cultivating a decentralized reputation that authentically reflects integrity, credibility, and trust across their professional networks and opportunities.
content.meta: Define Protocol is an identity tooling platform. Discover Define Protocol and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
